summary.en: Kogoro took his kids to the Birdman Rally held at Hikone, where Beika University will be participating in the manual division for the first time in ten years. Heiji also took Kazuha there as they never miss this yearly event. Two of the Beika University members come to say hi to Kogoro–Aero Quest airframe designer Yuma Masaki, and Aero Quest pilot Sho Ishizumi. The event kicks off as Beika University members are making final adjustments to the Aero Quest, while Yuma has to get something he left on the school bus–where he gets knocked out, dragged away, and shoved in a vehicle. Moments later, Ran and Kazuha spot Yuma’s younger sister Rin looking for him, so they decide to search for him. Eventually, the tablet Yuma never goes without is found under the school bus, to which Conan and Heiji also find the traces left from the kidnapping. Rin has to leave early because it’s almost Aero Quest’s turn to compete; and Conan entrusts her with one of his detective badges, saying it was a lucky charm for Ishizumi. At the end of the kidnapping traces is an empty slot of the parking lot, so while Ran and Kazuha return to their seats, Heiji and Conan inquire the security guard about the car that used to park at the said slot. The guard recognizes the vehicle, and remembers a valuable detail about its driver: A young man wearing a bracelet engraved with the word “shita”–reminding Conan of a serial robber gang.
